listed.text: Cone-shaped cast iron base, 170.2 mm across
listed.source: Anglepoise Type 75 Mini technical sheet (US - V2), https://cdn11.bigcommerce.com/s-kvxianwgwu/content/product-files/type-75-mini-desk-lamp.pdf: base diameter 6.7 in, cast iron base. The height, rim and top flat are modelling choices. min_thickness is the height.

listed.text: Lower arm, a round aluminium tube standing on the base
listed.source: Anglepoise Type 75 Mini technical sheet (US - V2), https://cdn11.bigcommerce.com/s-kvxianwgwu/content/product-files/type-75-mini-desk-lamp.pdf: aluminum arms. The 16 mm diameter, the 240 mm length and the lean are modelling choices. The lamp is spring-balanced and the arm is held by its pivot, not by its weight on the base, so the row is bonded. min_thickness is the diameter.

listed.text: Upper arm, a round aluminium tube meeting the lower arm
listed.source: Anglepoise Type 75 Mini technical sheet (US - V2), https://cdn11.bigcommerce.com/s-kvxianwgwu/content/product-files/type-75-mini-desk-lamp.pdf: aluminum arms. The sizes and the rise are modelling choices. A spring and friction joint holds it, not its weight, so the row is bonded. min_thickness is the diameter.

listed.text: Bell shade with a neck, on the end of the upper arm
listed.source: Anglepoise Type 75 Mini technical sheet (US - V2), https://cdn11.bigcommerce.com/s-kvxianwgwu/content/product-files/type-75-mini-desk-lamp.pdf: shade diameter 5.1 in, shade height 5.9 in, aluminum shade. The profile, the neck and the 1 mm wall are modelling choices. The arm's joint holds it, so the row is bonded. min_thickness is the wall.

listed.text: Cable, from the base to the plug
listed.source: Anglepoise Type 75 Mini technical sheet (US - V2), https://cdn11.bigcommerce.com/s-kvxianwgwu/content/product-files/type-75-mini-desk-lamp.pdf: cable length 70.9 in. The 5 mm diameter and the route are modelling choices; only part of the 70.9 in is drawn, the rest is slack off the desk. It is moulded into the base and the plug, so the row is bonded. min_thickness is the diameter.

listed.text: Plug body, standing on the strip's outlet face
listed.source: Anglepoise Type 75 Mini technical sheet (US - V2), https://cdn11.bigcommerce.com/s-kvxianwgwu/content/product-files/type-75-mini-desk-lamp.pdf: plug 2-blade US plug to NEMA 1-15. The body size is a modelling choice (no source publishes a moulded plug body). min_thickness is its smallest side.

listed.text: Two plug blades, hanging from the plug body
listed.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NEMA_connector (secondary; the primary ANSI/NEMA WD 6 is paywalled): NEMA 1-15P blades 1/4 in wide (5/16 in for the neutral), 0.06 in thick, 15.9 to 18.3 mm long, 1/2 in apart. The length is the middle of that range. They are moulded into the plug body, so the row is bonded. min_thickness is the blade thickness.

Lamp.done: An Anglepoise Type 75 Mini desk lamp in one reading pose: a cone-shaped base, two round arms, a bell shade, and a cable from the base to a 2-blade plug.

connectors.why: the lamp's own cable is 70.9 in (1.80 m) long (maker's sheet); it runs from the cord exit on the base to the plug standing in an outlet of the strip

view.why: A desk lamp, seen from the chair. The person's eyes are about an arm's length, 0.5 m, from the shade they reach for and move, and nobody looks at it from nearer in use. This is an estimate from that use, not a measured study.
view.hidden_why: the base stands on the desk, so its underside is never seen
view.farthest_why: Everything on the desk lies within its far edge: the chair puts the eyes about 0.5 m from the desk's near edge and the slab is 0.8 m deep, so 1.3 m. This is an estimate from that use, to be confirmed.

listed.text: Housing with six NEMA 5-15R outlets cut in as bores
listed.source: Tripp Lite PS615 datasheet, https://assets.testequity.com/te1/Documents/pdf/tripplite/Tripp-Lite_PS615_Datasheet.pdf: 10.8 x 1.85 x 1.23 in read as length x width x height, six outlets 28.5 mm apart in a single row, plastic, light gray. listed.text: Illuminated switch, on the outlet face near the cord end
listed.source: Tripp Lite PS615 datasheet, https://assets.testequity.com/te1/Documents/pdf/tripplite/Tripp-Lite_PS615_Datasheet.pdf: illuminated on/off switch. Its size and place are modelling choices (not published). min_thickness is its smallest side.

listed.text: Printed TRIPP-LITE logo, on the outlet face
listed.source: Tripp Lite PS615 datasheet, https://assets.testequity.com/te1/Documents/pdf/tripplite/Tripp-Lite_PS615_Datasheet.pdf, product photograph: the logo is printed on the top face at the cord end. Its size is a modelling choice; an oval stands for the lettering. min_thickness is a 4 micron pad-print ink film (Inkcups ICN-B150 manual).

form.why: an oval the size of the logo's box stands for the wordmark
